statement: Political support is not converted into formal mandate｜政治支持未轉成正式授權
mitigation: Obtain charter, decision rights, sponsor and escalation route
trigger: No signed mandate by concept phase

statement: Transaction model selected before evidence｜交易模式先於證據決定
mitigation: Complete demand, fiscal, legal and risk-allocation options appraisal

statement: One generic hospital model is applied to all opportunities｜單一醫院模式套用所有商機
mitigation: Use scenario-specific service, demand and operating model

statement: Demand or revenue is overestimated｜需求或收入高估
mitigation: Independent demand review and downside scenarios
trigger: Low referral conversion or payer uncertainty

statement: Long-term O&M and contract variation are unaffordable｜長期維運與變更不可負擔
mitigation: Whole-life model, variation governance and affordability cap

statement: No licensed and accountable clinical operator｜缺少合格且負責的臨床營運方
mitigation: Select operator early and define clinical accountability

statement: Hospital, practitioner or device licensing delays｜醫院、人員或醫材執照延誤
mitigation: Regulatory critical path and product-by-product register

statement: Cloud or data design breaches Vietnam requirements｜雲端或資料設計違反越南要求
mitigation: Data classification, local counsel, residency and transfer assessment

statement: Vendor lock-in and proprietary interfaces｜供應商鎖定與封閉介面
mitigation: Contractual APIs, data portability, conformance tests and exit plan

statement: Connected devices and OT are not segmented｜醫材與OT未分區
mitigation: Asset identity, segmentation, monitoring and IEC 80001 risk process

statement: Imported model cannot be operated by Vietnam teams｜外來模式無法由越南團隊運作
mitigation: Localization KPIs, ToT and handover acceptance

statement: Imported spares and consumables cause downtime｜進口備品耗材造成停機
mitigation: Local service coverage, buffer policy and alternatives
trigger: Single source or long lead time

statement: Facility, devices and IT are procured in silos｜設施、醫材與資訊分開採購
mitigation: Common architecture, interface responsibility and integrated tests

statement: Opening date drives unsafe go-live｜開院日期壓過安全條件
mitigation: Hard clinical safety gate and phased activation

statement: External message is technology-led or politically insensitive｜對外論述過度技術或政治敏感
mitigation: Use Vietnam-led, patient-outcome and local-capacity narrative

statement: 越南盾匯率與資金匯出限制侵蝕美元計價報酬｜FX & repatriation risk
mitigation: 合約幣別條款、自然對沖（在地成本在地收）、分潤模式優先於一次性大額收款
trigger: VND對USD年貶幅>3%或外匯管制收緊

statement: VSS健保給付延遲或給付價低於成本（洗腎/放療/遠距商機的現金流基礎）｜VSS payment risk
mitigation: 先查證同類機構實際回款天數；混合付費設計（VSS+自費+保險）；營運資金緩衝6個月
trigger: 同業回款天數>90天或給付價調降

statement: AI法134/2025合規時程卡住全部17個AI商機（高風險登記/在地代表/2027/9補件）｜AI Act timeline
mitigation: 把OPP-59（AI法規顧問）當第一個做的AI生意：自己先走一遍流程再賣給別人
trigger: 首個AI產品登記受阻或超過90天

statement: 白地商機投入後市場不如預期（③尚未出現＝也可能是沒需求而不是沒人做）｜White-space risk
mitigation: 白地商機一律先PoC/示範案再擴大；設停損點（PoC預算上限與6個月檢核）；13④逐週追蹤

statement: 關鍵缺口夥伴談不下來，牽動多個商機連鎖延誤（CAP-030牽動7個、CAP-028牽動6個）｜Anchor partner risk
mitigation: 每個高牽動缺口同時接觸2-3家候選（98名冊）；備援方案（代理/合資/自建）預先評估
trigger: 單一缺口洽談>90天無進展

statement: competitor在地國家隊（VinBrain/Viettel/FPT/白梅）以低價或政策關係卡位｜Incumbent response
mitigation: 避開國家隊主場（通用影像AI/基層HIS），走利基與服務層（15的W欄切入角度）；與其合作優先於對抗
trigger: 目標商機出現國家隊免費/超低價方案
